plugins.name: Plugins
plugins.description: Install sandboxed plugins: card types, study modes, voices, hooks and more.

tts.name: Text to speech
tts.description: Reads cards aloud through the installed voice providers.

audio_fill.name: Missing audio
audio_fill.description: Gives every card sound: the film's own line, else a cut from your local video file, else a voice reading the word.

timeout_ms.label: Time limit per call (ms)
timeout_ms.description: A plugin call that takes longer than this is stopped (work it asks the app to do counts too). E.g. 3000 ms → work not done in 3 seconds is cut off.

fuel_millions.label: Work limit per call (millions of steps)
fuel_millions.description: Stops a plugin stuck in a loop even if the clock is slow.

memory_mb.label: Memory limit (MB)
memory_mb.description: Most memory one plugin call may use.

max_failures.label: Failures before switching off
max_failures.description: A plugin that fails this many times in a row is switched off and you are told. You can switch it back on yourself.

before_hook_failure.label: When a plugin check fails
before_hook_failure.description: Continue without the plugin, or cancel the action.

max_hooks_per_action.label: Plugin reactions per action
max_hooks_per_action.description: Most hooks each plugin may run in one action of yours. Past it, that plugin's remaining reactions in the action are skipped.

kv_max_keys.label: Storage entries per plugin
kv_max_keys.description: Most entries one plugin may keep in its own storage.

kv_max_mb.label: Storage size per plugin (MB)
kv_max_mb.description: Most space one plugin's own storage may take.

max_host_calls.label: Requests per plugin call
max_host_calls.description: Most requests one plugin call may make to the app. A plugin going past it is stopped.

host_mb_per_call.label: Data per plugin call (MB)
host_mb_per_call.description: Most data one plugin call may send to and get from the app.

hook_ms_per_action.label: Plugin reaction time per action (ms)
hook_ms_per_action.description: Most time each plugin's hooks may take together in one action of yours. Past it, that plugin's remaining reactions in the action are skipped.

provider.label: Voice provider
provider.description: Empty = the first available one. On Windows that is the voices Windows already has (offline, no key): builtin.system.

clip_offset_ms.label: Clip shift (ms)
clip_offset_ms.description: If your video file's timing differs from the one you watched, shift the cuts by this much (negative = earlier).

plugins.heading: Plugins
plugins.intro: Plugins add new card types, study modes or voices to the app. If you got a .fcplugin file, install it here and switch it on or off.
plugins.failures: {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}} in a row
plugins.grant_hint: The plugin can only do what is ticked. Those marked “asks separately” (internet, microphone, files, AI) start unticked; tick them if you need them. You can change this later.

notice.hooks_skipped: Some plugins reacted too often in one action, so their remaining reactions were skipped ({names}; at most {max, plural, one {# reaction} other {# reactions}} or {ms} ms per plugin). Nothing was switched off.

plugins.empty_hint: Plugins add card types, study modes and voices. They run in a sandbox.
plugins.permissions_hint: The plugin can only do what is ticked. Untick a permission and that feature stops working, but the rest of the plugin still runs.

how.title: What is a plugin?
how.what: A plugin is a small program written by someone else: it adds new card types, study modes, voices or commands to the app.
how.sandbox: It runs in a sandbox: it can reach your cards, files or the internet only as far as the permissions you give it. Every run has a time, memory and work limit; a plugin that keeps failing is switched off by itself.
how.off: Switch it off and the plugin doesn't run at all but stays installed. Uninstall it and it is removed; cards it made stay where they are.

limits.summary: Time, memory and storage limits plugins run under. Look here if a plugin keeps stopping at a limit.
limits.heading: Resource limits
limits.description: These limits apply to every plugin. A plugin that goes past one is stopped for that run; if it keeps failing it is switched off. Raising a limit makes room for a slow plugin but also lets a faulty one tie up the app for longer.
limits.none: The limits could not be loaded, or the plugins module is off.

perm.unknown: Reaches a part of the app.
perm.network: Can connect to {host} on the internet, and nowhere else.

host.ai_invoke: Can use AI with your key (may cost money).
host.audio_record: Can record sound with the microphone.
host.fs_pick: Can read a file, only one you choose.
host.models_manage: Can download and delete the model files it needs.
host.tts_provide: Adds a voice that reads cards aloud.
host.storage_kv: Can keep data in its own small storage.

hook.before: Can step in before an action ({target}) and change or stop it.
hook.event: Is told when something happens in the app ({target}).

area.words: which words you know (the word index)

word_decks.get: Decks a plugin may learn words from
word_decks.set: Limit the decks a plugin may learn words from

media.origins: Where the sound and picture came from

validation.plugin_permission: The plugin did not ask for this permission.
validation.plugin_host_limit: A plugin asked too much of the app at once ({function}: {limit}, at most {max}).
